# HakoDB Docs — llms.txt

> HakoDB: embedded document database (Rust) with vector + graph search and multi-plane sync. These notes map the manual at https://hakodb.github.io/docs/ for AI assistants. Code identifiers are exact; verify signatures against hakodb source or docs.rs before generating calls.

- Start here: intro, concepts (collections, typed values, in-process model), choosing a mode (embedded vs net/cloud/socket sync).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/intro.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/concepts.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/choosing-mode.html
- Core: CRUD (put/get/patch/delete/subdocuments), queries (filters, order, cursors, aggregates, planner), indexes (secondary/composite/FTS, background readiness).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/crud.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/queries.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/indexes.html
- Vector KNN: create_vector_index + find_near, LE-f32 fields, cosine/L2, index-before-write, one-model rule, graphs rebuild locally.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/vector.html
- Graph: Reference edges, create_traverse_index + find_paths (BFS, depth 1..=32), create_edge_index + via_edge/weight_field Dijkstra, untracked-incoming errors loudly.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/graph.html
- Writes: write_batch (atomic), serializable transactions (conflict retry), watch_collection streams, durability modes, encryption, compression, backup/recovery.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/transactions.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/watch.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/durability.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backup-recovery.html
- Errors: HakoError variants (Io, LockPoisoned, StorageError, QueryError, IndexError, Corrupt, InvalidInput); fail-closed rules (loud over empty, no silent clamping).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/errors.html
- Sync: rooms, versions/deltas, LWW, echo suppression, withheld/excluded/local-only, same-minor lockstep; mesh guide (mDNS, rooms, troubleshooting), cloud guide (server/client, VersionPing, auth), socket plane (unix, balancer), encryption posture (wire vs at-rest, caps rule, operating).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-concepts.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-mesh.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-cloud.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-socket.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sync-encryption.html
- Cluster: hakocluster dispatcher (reads fan out, writes route, promote/epoch, health), multidb Databases registry (exact-name, per-db mesh dirs, FFI), Hako-only members, socket-sync companion, hakobackend relevance.
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/cluster.html
- SDKs: C ABI (179 fns, handles, ownership, status codes), JS/TS (@hakodb/client: open, collection/doc, where/orderBy, onSnapshot), Go (cgo, explicit Free), Pascal (THako/THKDocument, try/finally), Tauri (gateway + @hakodb/tauri modular API), CLI (get/set/query/traverse/vector/serve), HTTP backend (hakobackend wire + @hakodb/backend client methods).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-c-abi.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-js.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-go.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-pascal.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-tauri.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-cli.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/sdk-backend.html
- Shipping: real-product recipes (Tauri offline-first, CLI tool, hakobackend web/mobile, LAN mesh, multi-instance cluster, analytics), operations (sizing, upgrades, backups, FAQ).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/recipes.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/operations.html
- Backend (hakobackend 0.9.0): gateway+drivers+policy+auth architecture, quickstart (static binary, path rule), TOML config (drivers, multidb, reload-vs-restart), aliases, indexes (kinds, coverage rule, vector/graph/archive), policy (default-deny, resolution, claim caveat), auth (chain, local BFF, DPoP, service keys), drivers (registry, conformance, writing one), realtime WS/SSE, files, TTL/unique/coalescing, deploy (systemd, backups, monitoring).
  https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-overview.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-quickstart.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-config.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-alias.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-indexes.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-policy.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-auth.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-drivers.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-realtime-files.html https://hakodb.github.io/docs/backend-deploy.html
- Source of truth for API: Rust engine `Hako` (97 pub fns), C ABI `hakodb.h` (179 fns), per-repo SDK READMEs under https://github.com/hakodb.
